name: Dirtywave M8 Tracker Model:02
firmware: M8 firmware 6.6.3 F (changelog 2026-10-20); operation manual v6.5.2 (2026-04-21)

midiIn.connector: 3.5 mm TRS type A in and out; USB-C class-compliant MIDI (behaves like the TRS input)
midiIn.note: DIN-to-TRS type A adapter from the Thru5 WC, or USB from a host.

clock.syncs: the song tempo and transport: SYNC IN = CLOCK, TRANSPORT, CLOCK+TRANSP., TRANSPORT+SPP or CLK+TRANSP+SPP
clock.setting: MIDI Settings > SYNC IN = CLK+TRANSP+SPP (per song)

channelSetting: MIDI Settings > Track MIDI Input: each M8 track has its own CHAN (default track n = channel n), INST#, PG CHANGE and MODE; stored in the song. Wrong Room: M8 track 1 CHAN 4, track 2 CHAN 10, track 3 CHAN 13, PG CHANGE on; tracks 4..8 on a channel nothing sends on, or on 13 in POLY.

channel.note: MIDI Settings view: a channel per track 1..8 (default track n = channel n), stored in the song; separate record (9), control-map (10 or ALL) and song-row-cue (11) channels. Tracks on one channel play together: MONO, LEGATO or POLY (round-robin). Wrong Room: three M8 parts on channels 4, 10 and 13 = M8 tracks 1, 2 and 3.

programChange.note: With PG CHANGE on, a PC on a track's channel selects that track's instrument INST 00..7F (hex). PC 0 = INST 00 is the natural reading; unverified. Bank select on receive is not documented.

controllers.name: No fixed CC list: per-song MIDI mappings (any CC on the control-map channel to instrument / mixer / effect / tempo / transpose parameters); CC 64 sustain on track input

setup: MIDI Settings (per song): track 1 CHAN 04, track 2 CHAN 10, track 3 CHAN 13; tracks 4..8 on a channel nothing sends on (or on 13 in POLY to add voices to part 3).
MIDI Settings: PG CHANGE = ON on tracks 1..3 (a PC on the channel selects that track's INST#).
MIDI Settings: SYNC IN = CLK+TRANSP+SPP so the M8 follows Classic Tabby's clock, Start, Stop and Song Position.
Save the song's MIDI settings as the default configuration (MIDI Settings page) so a new M8 song keeps them.
Name the instruments in the song; the rig profile can name INST 00..7F for the editor.
notes: Instruments are per-song user content (00..7F hex); no factory names.
Firmware 6.6.3 F (2026-10-20) at research time; manual v6.5.2 (2026-04-21). The 2023 manual's screenshot gives the defaults (track n = channel n, PG CHANGE ON, LEGATO).
